Pulmonary Circulation refers to circulation from the RV through the pulmonary vessels to the LA

Systemic Circulation refers to the circulation from the LV through systemic circulation → Ra → RV

Major differences:

+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                   | **Systemic Circulation**                                                             | **Pulmonary Circulation**                                                                |
+===================================+======================================================================================+==========================================================================================+
| **Function**                      | Oxygen delivery to tissues, removal of CO2 metabolic waste                           | Gas exchange - offload CO2, oxygenate Hb                                                 |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
|                                   | Delivery of blood to organs and transport of products                                | Metabolism and                                                                           |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
|                                   | Blood reservoir                                                                      |                                                                                          |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Anatomy**                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Circulation                       | Left Atrium → Left Ventricle →Systemic circulation → Right Atrium → Right Ventricle  | Right Ventricle → Pulmonary Arteries → Pulmonary Veins → Left Atrium                     |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
|                                   | (Small volume from Systemic circulation to bronchial arteries →pulmonary veins)      | Thin walled - easily dispensable, minimal Smooth muscle                                  |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
|                                   | Thick walled Smooth muscle ++                                                        | 16% of total circulating volume (800ml)                                                  |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
|                                   | 76% (3500ml) Total Circulating volume                                                |                                                                                          |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Innervation                       | Extensive sympathetic innervation and response                                       | Sympathetic innervation but minimal response                                             |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Haemodynamics**                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Pressures                         | High                                                                                 | Low                                                                                      |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
| Systolic                          | 120mmHg                                                                              | 25mmHg                                                                                   |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
| Diastolic                         | 80mmHg                                                                               | 8mmHg                                                                                    |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
| MAP                               | 90mmHg                                                                               | 15mmHg                                                                                   |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
| Venous                            | \~7mmHG                                                                              | \~6mmHg                                                                                  |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Resistance                        | 800-1200 dyn.sec/cm5                                                                 | 80-120 dyn.sec/cm5                                                                       |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Summary of Pressure / Resistance  | High Pressure, high resistance circuit                                               | Low Pressure, low resistance circuit                                                     |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
|                                   | Continues flow (windkessel)                                                          | Pulsatile blood flow                                                                     |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Effects of Gravity                | Larger difference in pressure central → peripheral \~120mmHg                         | Smaller difference in pressure difference Base → Apex 20mmHg                             |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
|                                   | Local auto regulation and nervous innervation maintains blood supply                 | Low resistance so when erect variable flow to apical regions of lung                     |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Effect Of lung volume             |                                                                                      | Lung volume has U shaped effect on PVR - PVR lowest at FRC and increased to RV and TLC   |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Effect of increased PVR           |                                                                                      | As flow and PVR are inversely proportional increasing PVR reduces blood flow             |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Regulation**                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Major determinant **            | Local auto-regulation                                                                | Hypoxic pulmonary vasoconstriction                                                       |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
|                                   | - SNS Innervation and myogenic effector                                              |                                                                                          |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Innervation**                   | SNS Dense supply → Vado constriction                                                 |                                                                                          |
|                                   |                                                                                      |                                                                                          |
|                                   | PsNS → Vaso Dilation                                                                 |                                                                                          |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
